name: @mmo/native
description: MixAI native shell — Tauri 2 (desktop) + Capacitor (mobile). Wraps https://mixai.ro and lets the existing PWA service worker handle offline.

scripts.cap:add:android: pnpm run build:web && cap add android
scripts.cap:add:ios: pnpm run build:web && cap add ios
scripts.android:build:debug: pnpm run cap:sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:build:release: pnpm run cap:sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease bundleRelease
scripts.ios:build: xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release -archivePath ios/build/App.xcarchive archive
